verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no local engine, emulator, or offline sandbox. Development happens on Snowflake cloud compute, through cell-by-cell Notebooks and dbt Projects on Snowflake. A trial account consumes credits, and users mitigate cost with XSMALL warehouses and resource monitors that suspend warehouses at a credit limit. Cloning exists, but the evidence only covers privilege inheritance, not dev-sandbox use. Missing for 10: a local or emulated Snowflake engine, a free persistent dev tier, documented zero-cost isolated sandboxes, and hands-on corroboration of a fast local dev loop.
